request.scheduleid: required. From get_schedule.php / get_schedule_patient.php. Agenda (lead) records carry one too.
request.obs: optional free-text note stored on the record.

state_map.0: REJECTED by the API as 'unknown status' (verified 2026-09-07). Consequence: a cancelled record cannot be set back to Programat through the API — there is no restore action.

other_states_seen_on_records.comment: MAN Find Target maps these state STRINGS when reading records. Their numeric values are NOT known, which is why guessing values in update_schedule is unsafe — a guess could mark a record completed or no-show.

hard_delete.claim: Reported by Optofarm 2026-09-14 that evolvo can now delete an appointment outright rather than only setting ANULAT. Believed to run through this same endpoint.
hard_delete.evidence_found: NONE. Zero references to any delete endpoint or delete parameter across all 112 workflow nodes, live or exported. Team's own sticky notes (2026-09-07) document 'update_schedule (state 1/2/3)' and carry a standing 'api still needed' flag.
hard_delete.caveat: Absence of evidence here is expected if the capability was added server-side — the workflow is the client and would not know. This is NOT a contradiction of the claim.
hard_delete.blocked_on: Written spec from Imreh, or the authorised probe below.
hard_delete.probe_results: NOT YET RUN — see probe-update-schedule.sh. Blocked on EVOLVO_API_KEY in the environment and a working-hours decision.

slot_release.question: After state 2 (ANULAT), when does the slot reappear in get_work_days.php?
slot_release.observed: Delayed in prior testing — roughly 50 minutes in one case. Mechanism unknown (cache / batch / staff-driven).
slot_release.impact: The voice agent offers `earliest` straight from get_work_days.php, so a stale view either hides a free slot or offers one that is gone.
slot_release.status: OPEN — see QUESTIONS_FOR_IMREH.md Q2. Probing cannot cleanly distinguish cache from batch from staff action.

known_quirks: post_schedule.php with an EMPTY email returns a misleading 401. Always send a non-empty email.
A freshly created booking has historically been invisible to get_schedule.php and get_schedule_patient.php on an immediate read.
get_schedule_patient.php does NOT return Agenda/lead records by phone (verified 2026-09-07); FIND and MAN scan get_schedule.php (schedule_form=0, 5 windows / 31 days) and match client-side.

RATE LIMIT: ~6-7 requests within a minute previously earned a plain-HTML Apache 403 on every endpoint including get_auth.php, and it did not clear within 5+ minutes. Max one request per 15 seconds. Never retry a plain-HTML 403.
